notes: House Wiki upgrade. The wiki is now backed up: every save keeps the previous copy on the server, and once a day the whole thing - wiki plus manuals and photos - is mirrored to the house share at S:\Backups\HomeHub\wiki. Links you put in a detail row (Amazon filter links and the like) are now an Open button instead of plain text. Each item card lists its own upkeep jobs with the next due date and a Done button, plus a Schedule upkeep shortcut. Adding an item pre-fills the usual detail rows for its category (Model, S/N, Purchased, Warranty until, Filter...). Also fixed: editing an item no longer wipes out its maintenance schedules.
